tasks.subject: Task 1: CsContrib -- contribution rows
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A pure library that turns a reconstructed survey into distance-and-percent rows by trip, team, person and survey run.

**Files:**
- Create: `scripts/CaveSurvey/Core/CsContrib.js`
- Modify: `scripts/CaveSurvey/Core/CsAll.js`
- Test: `tests/js_unit.js`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- `CsContrib.byTrip` returns one row per `survey.trips` entry with distance, percent, shotCount, stationCount, date, team, name, label
- Summed distance over trip rows equals `CsStats.compute(...).surveyedLength` for the same survey
- `CsContrib.people("Nathan, Jim and Sarah/Bob & Ann")` returns the five names
- `CsContrib.byPerson` credits each person the FULL distance of every trip they were on and sets `overlapping` when credited totals exceed the survey total
- `CsContrib.byRun` sums a leg into the run its TO station belongs to
- A zero-length survey returns percent 0, never NaN
- `CsAll.js` includes `CsContrib.js`

**Verify:** `bash tests/run_all.sh` -> `### UNIT OK <n> assertions`, no `### UNIT FAIL`

**Steps:** write the unit section in tests/js_unit.js first (full code in the plan), watch it fail, write CsContrib.js, add the CsAll include, re-run under node and then under CaveCAD's own engine, commit.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["scripts/CaveSurvey/Core/CsContrib.js", "scripts/CaveSurvey/Core/CsAll.js", "tests/js_unit.js"], "verifyCommand": "bash tests/run_all.sh", "acceptanceCriteria": ["byTrip rows sum to CsStats.surveyedLength", "people() splits on comma, and, slash, ampersand", "byPerson credits trips in full and flags overlapping", "byRun attributes a leg by its TO station", "empty survey gives percent 0 not NaN", "CsAll includes CsContrib.js"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: CsFocus -- what a selection makes visible
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A pure library that turns a set of station names into a per-entity visibility answer, reading the same tags `CsDraw.eraseStations` reads, with a test that fails if the two lists diverge.

**Files:**
- Create: `scripts/CaveSurvey/Core/CsFocus.js`
- Modify: `scripts/CaveSurvey/Core/CsAll.js`
- Test: `tests/js_unit.js`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- `CsFocus.TAG_RULES` names every station-bearing tag eraseStations reads; a test parsing `CsDraw.js` fails on divergence either way
- `CsFocus.stationsOf(entity)` returns `{names, kind}` with kind suite/linework/profile/none
- An untagged entity is visible under every station set
- A `Shot` needs BOTH ends in focus; `WallRunStations` needs ANY
- `A3.L2` and `A3.4` attribute to `A3`
- `CsFocus.stationSet` unions trips, teams, people and runs; a blank station name never enters the set
- `CsFocus.isPlanFrame` is false for `CTRL-PROFILE-*` and `PROFILE-*`
- `CsAll.js` includes `CsFocus.js`

**Verify:** `bash tests/run_all.sh` -> `### UNIT OK <n> assertions`, no `### UNIT FAIL`

**Steps:** write the unit section (full code in the plan, including the eraseStations tag-parity test), watch it fail, write CsFocus.js, add the CsAll include, re-run both engines, commit.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["scripts/CaveSurvey/Core/CsFocus.js", "scripts/CaveSurvey/Core/CsAll.js", "tests/js_unit.js"], "verifyCommand": "bash tests/run_all.sh", "acceptanceCriteria": ["TAG_RULES and eraseStations read the same tags, pinned by a test", "untagged entities always visible", "Shot needs both ends, WallRunStations needs any", "LRUD and splay suffixes strip to their station", "stationSet unions and drops blanks", "isPlanFrame excludes both profile spellings"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: The window, showing the whole drawing
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Cave Survey > Trip Focus opens a standalone, non-modal window containing a live, pannable view of a PRIVATE COPY of the drawing -- no filtering yet, and provably nothing written to the user's document.

**Files:**
- Create: `scripts/CaveSurvey/TripFocus/TripFocus.js`
- Create: `scripts/CaveSurvey/TripFocus/TripFocus.svg`
- Modify: `README.md` (the `## The tools` table)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- `tripfocus` and `tf` both open the window; it appears in the Cave Survey menu and toolbar
- Non-modal (`show()`, never `exec()`): the main window still works while it is open
- The view shows the drawing and pans/zooms
- `doc.isModified()` unchanged by opening, using and closing the window
- The main window's selection is unchanged (this is what `setSelectionOnly(false)` buys)
- Closing destroys the scratch document interface via `destr`
- sortOrder 30 is unique; the README table lists `tripfocus`

**Verify:** `bash tests/run_all.sh` green and `CAVESURVEY_PUBLISH_CHECK=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` OK, then in a GUI CaveCAD: open a survey drawing, type `tf`, confirm the window opens with the drawing in it and the main document shows no modified marker

**Steps:** write TripFocus.js (full code in the plan: buildPreview with RCopyOperation + setSelectionOnly(false), RGraphicsViewQt on RGraphicsSceneQt, non-modal QDialog, cleanUp with destr), draw TripFocus.svg, add the README row, run the structural tests, check it in the GUI, commit.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["scripts/CaveSurvey/TripFocus/TripFocus.js", "scripts/CaveSurvey/TripFocus/TripFocus.svg", "README.md"], "verifyCommand": "bash tests/run_all.sh && CAVESURVEY_PUBLISH_CHECK=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s tests", "acceptanceCriteria": ["tf and tripfocus open a non-modal window", "the view renders the drawing and pans/zooms", "isModified and the selection are unchanged", "closing destr's the scratch di", "sort order 30 unique and README row present"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: The contributions list
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Fill the window's left pane with four sections -- Trips, Teams, People, Survey runs -- each row showing distance and percent, each row checkable.

**Files:**
- Create: `scripts/CaveSurvey/TripFocus/TripFocusRows.js`
- Modify: `scripts/CaveSurvey/TripFocus/TripFocus.js`
- Test: `tests/js_unit.js`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- A `QTreeWidget` with three columns (contributor, distance, share) and four top-level sections
- Every row shows `CsContrib.distanceText` and `CsContrib.percentText` values
- The People section shows `CsContrib.PERSON_CREDIT_NOTE` when credit overlaps
- Checking a section checks its children; an empty section reads "(none recorded)" and is disabled, not absent
- `TripFocus.picked(tree)` returns `{trips, teams, people, runs}`
- A drawing with no survey opens with every section empty and no exception

**Verify:** `bash tests/run_all.sh` green; in the GUI, `tf` on the Pitfall Cave fixture lists its four trips with distances that sum to the title block Length

**Steps:** write the TripFocusRows unit section, watch it fail, write TripFocusRows.js, then the tree/splitter/cascade wiring in TripFocus.js (full code in the plan), GUI check against the Pitfall fixture, commit.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["scripts/CaveSurvey/TripFocus/TripFocusRows.js", "scripts/CaveSurvey/TripFocus/TripFocus.js", "tests/js_unit.js"], "verifyCommand": "bash tests/run_all.sh", "acceptanceCriteria": ["four sections always, empty ones disabled and labelled", "rows carry formatted distance and share", "People section carries the credit note when overlapping", "section checkbox cascades to children", "picked() returns the four lists", "a survey-less drawing opens without exception"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: Filtering the view
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Checking rows filters the preview: only entities attributable to the checked stations are drawn, the profile band never is, and All / Refresh work.

**Files:**
- Modify: `scripts/CaveSurvey/TripFocus/TripFocus.js`
- Create: `tests/trip_focus_filter.js`
- Modify: `tests/run_all.sh`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Checking one trip draws that trip's stations, labels, legs, LRUD, splays, notes and wall runs and hides the others
- Nothing on a profile-frame layer is ever drawn in the window
- Untagged entities stay drawn under every selection
- Checking nothing shows everything
- All checks every row; Refresh rebuilds the copy and the list
- Un-hiding works after a focus (requires `op.setAllowInvisible(true)`; without it the modify is refused silently)
- The scratch operations are non-undoable (`new RModifyObjectsOperation(false)`)
- The user's document is untouched: isModified, selection and undo stack unchanged

**Verify:** `/Applications/CaveCAD.app/Contents/MacOS/CaveCAD -no-dock-icon -no-gui -allow-multiple-instances -autostart tests/trip_focus_filter.js "$PWD"` prints `### FILTER OK 9 checks`, then the nine-point GUI walkthrough in the plan

**Steps:** write tests/trip_focus_filter.js (hand-built tagged entities, full code in the plan), watch it fail, add TripFocus.applyFocus / refresh / reapply / wireTree and the All and Refresh buttons, wire the test into run_all.sh, run the GUI walkthrough, commit.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["scripts/CaveSurvey/TripFocus/TripFocus.js", "tests/trip_focus_filter.js", "tests/run_all.sh"], "verifyCommand": "bash tests/run_all.sh", "acceptanceCriteria": ["a focused trip draws, the rest hide", "profile-frame geometry never draws", "untagged entities always draw", "empty selection shows everything", "All un-hides everything (setAllowInvisible)", "operations are non-undoable", "the user document is untouched"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 6: Ship it
tasks.description:
**BLOCKED ON A HUMAN.** Everything except the version bump and publish is done. The GUI gate (15 checks) is in the design doc and has to be run by a person in CaveCAD before this ships: a green suite has already been wrong four times here about whether the window can even open. - The version is bumped the way the repo already bumps it (read `git log -- tools/publish.sh README.md` first; do not invent a scheme)

**Verify:** `CAVESURVEY_PUBLISH_CHECK=1 bash tests/run_all.sh` -> all sections OK, then `tools/publish.sh` -> exits 0

tasks.subject: Task 7: Wall runs carry their own stations
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A generated LRUD wall run is tagged with the stations IT followed, not every station in the drawing, so a focus can tell one passage's walls from another's.

**Files:**
- Modify: `scripts/CaveSurvey/Core/CsLrud.js`
- Modify: `scripts/CaveSurvey/Core/CsDraw.js`
- Test: `tests/js_unit.js`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- wallRuns reports per-run station names alongside its points
- CsDraw tags each wall polyline with only its own run's stations
- two disjoint passages produce non-overlapping station lists
- eraseStations still replaces a run when any of ITS stations is redrawn, and no longer kills runs from passages that were not redrawn
- CsFocus.isVisible hides an unfocused passage's wall run, asserted against a REALLY drawn document not a hand-written tag

**Verify:** `bash tests/run_all.sh`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["scripts/CaveSurvey/Core/CsLrud.js", "scripts/CaveSurvey/Core/CsDraw.js", "tests/js_unit.js"], "verifyCommand": "bash tests/run_all.sh", "acceptanceCriteria": ["per-run station names returned", "per-run tagging in CsDraw", "disjoint passages tag disjointly", "erase precision both halves asserted", "CsFocus hides an unfocused passage's walls on a drawn document"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 8: Rebuild the list pane on constructible widgets
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Build the contributions list from QCheckBox + QLabel in a QGridLayout inside a QScrollArea. QTreeWidget, QTreeWidgetItem's checkState and QListWidget are NOT constructible from script in this build -- probed in CaveCAD 3.33.0's engine. The tree version threw on setHeaderLabels for every drawing while run_all.sh stayed green, because no test constructed the widget.

**Files:**
- Modify: `scripts/CaveSurvey/TripFocus/TripFocus.js`
- Test: `tests/js_unit.js`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- no QTreeWidget/QTreeWidgetItem/QListWidget anywhere in the add-on
- QScrollArea over a QGridLayout, checkbox + distance + share per row, trailing stretch row
- four section headers, each a QCheckBox that cascades to its rows
- empty section shows a disabled '(none recorded)' label, no checkbox
- the '(not in any run)' row has no checkbox
- selection state in a JS entries array, NOT recovered by walking widget children
- picked() covered by a headless test that constructs real QCheckBox widgets and ticks them
- every user-visible string wrapped in qsTr

**Verify:** `bash tests/run_all.sh` plus a headless probe asserting picked() reflects ticked boxes

```json:metadata
{"files": ["scripts/CaveSurvey/TripFocus/TripFocus.js", "tests/js_unit.js"], "verifyCommand": "bash tests/run_all.sh", "acceptanceCriteria": ["no unconstructible widget classes remain", "grid pane with cascade", "selection in a JS array not the widget tree", "picked() tested headlessly with real checkboxes", "opens on survey/no-survey/empty drawings"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```
